_comment: The sizes, in bytes, of the demo's private media, which is never committed (share/assets/private/, git-ignored). `omacar demo check` (lib/democheck.py) holds the files to these, so a song cut short by a copy that stopped half way is caught before the show and not in the middle of it. The songs are Omarchy Radio's, as checked against github.com/omacom/radio.omarchy.org at 023a8f5c62ab.
